upstream_benchmarks.notes: Selected acceptance dataset. Oracle baseline must be measured; do not substitute publisher streaming scores.

reference_rationale: Publisher R2T2 state machine at 80c22e6140bcb9166fb9906798894fc8b18c8309 is authoritative for stable prefixes and finalization; ordinary Qwen transcription does not implement this contract. audio.cpp a7b58a6 is a secondary implementation reference, not the numerical oracle.
known_risks: Published audio.cpp GGUF embeds JSON resources and original tensor names, whereas transcribe requires stt.* metadata and mapped tensor names; direct catalogue alias is incompatible.
LSP requires rollback in token space, UTF-8 safe stable prefixes, punctuation/repetition repair, pipe truncation, and authoritative final text.
Publisher streaming implementation requires vLLM; Windows native reference execution cannot use this backend directly. WSL Ubuntu exists but has no uv reference environment yet.

Pinned publisher config uses thinker_config, compatible with the existing Qwen hparam layout. The sibling implementation additionally accepts a flattened layout; do not assume artifacts use identical packaging. Verify tied output weights.
Streaming re-encodes accumulated audio; graph capacity bucketing needs valid-prefix masks and numerical validation, especially when buckets grow or shrink.
Reference dtype is BF16. Published F16 and Q8 GGUF are secondary artifacts, not BF16 oracle replacements.
Only Q8_0 or higher precision is supported by the sibling implementation; no lower-bit catalogue variants are authorized by evidence.
Context and hotwords deferred by user on 2026-09-20.
Audio.cpp uses 30-second offline windows; confirm publisher context/reset behavior before adopting limits for streaming.
